title: Docusign Acquires Suplari to Accelerate AI-Powered Contract Management for Procurement
summary: Suplari’s technology and expertise will strengthen the IAM platform, building on Docusign’s leadership position in contract management and accelerating the development of new capabilities that help procurement teams put AI to work more effectively.
body_markdown:
Docusign announced its acquisition of Suplari, an AI-native procurement intelligence company. The acquisition will bring Suplari’s technology and expertise to the Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) platform, accelerating the development of procurement solutions. The IAM platform will expand to help businesses put contract terms to work, using AI to reduce costs and risks, manage supplier obligations, and stay ahead of renewals.


Procurement teams often have to piece together information across contracts, finance systems, and spreadsheets to make strategic sourcing and buying decisions. Bringing Suplari’s AI-powered spending and supplier insights into IAM helps Docusign supercharge existing procurement solutions and deliver more advanced capabilities. For five consecutive years, Suplari was named to[The Hackett Group’s “50 to Know” opens in a new tab](https://www.thehackettgroup.com/vendor-recognition/#50toknow) list of procurement technology providers as well as being named a 2026 Top Tech for Spend Analytics.


Docusign plans to combine Suplari’s capabilities with its IAM platform to help procurement teams:


-


**Uncover savings with AI agents.** Combine Suplari’s procurement intelligence with Docusign’s agreement AI engine, called Iris, to identify opportunities to consolidate purchases, reduce unnecessary spending, and capture negotiated savings.


-


**Expanded obligation tracking and supplier accountability:** Use Iris to identify commitments in supplier agreements combined with Suplari’s intelligence to monitor fulfillment, spot gaps, and follow up sooner.


-


**Strengthen negotiations and renewal decisions.** Connect spending patterns with contract terms so teams can better assess supplier performance, identify negotiation opportunities, and make informed decisions before renewing or renegotiating.


-


**Spot risks and act sooner.** Use Iris to monitor spending and supplier agreements, flag potential issues such as purchases outside agreed terms, and guide teams toward the right next steps with clear priorities and recommended actions.


-


**Connect to the procurement ecosystem.** Expand upon Docusign and Suplari integrations with business systems, such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, and Oracle, to bring agreement intelligence and workflows into everyday procurement solutions.


Suplari’s technology and expertise will strengthen the IAM platform, accelerating development of new capabilities that help procurement teams put AI to work more effectively. This acquisition builds on Docusign’s established leadership position in contract management. Docusign was named a Leader in the[2026 IDC MarketScape for Worldwide Integrated Signing Workflow Software](https://www.docusign.com/resources/research/idc-marketscape-for-signing-workflows) and has been recognized as a Leader in the[Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CLM](https://www.docusign.com/gartner-magic-quadrant-contract-lifecycle-management) for six consecutive years.


Learn how procurement teams at[Avis Budget Group](https://www.docusign.com/customer-stories/avis-budget-group-drives-smarter-faster-more-strategic-procurement-with-ai) ,[Flowserve](https://www.docusign.com/customer-stories/flowserve-boosts-speed-and-profit-margins-with-docusign-clm-and-salesforce) , and[Catchafire](https://www.docusign.com/customer-stories/catchafire-doubles-contracting-capacity-accelerating-nonprofit-partnerships) are using Docusign to streamline contracting and drive better business outcomes.


Terms of the transaction are not disclosed.
